audit.whatIsWrong: The level chart and the whys openly disagree on this page: win[] gives Fiora six of seven stages while whys[0], whys[2], whys[3] and whys[5] all describe Malphite winning those same stages, and packet.levelChart matches the whys exactly (Malphite/Skill/Malphite/Malphite/Fiora/Malphite/Skill).
audit.why: I did NOT change any side value. The mirror audit (malphite__fiora) hit the same conflict from the other direction and deliberately left sides alone, noting a 56.8% Emerald+ win rate over 970 games on Malphite's packet against 46.05% over 1062 games on this one. Flipping one side alone would create exactly the mirror contradiction mirror-fix.js exists to overwrite, and the two packets cannot both be right.

audit.whatIsWrong: No cooldowns for Unstoppable Force anywhere, and Granite Shield's recharge condition — the thing that decides whether your chip sticks — is never stated.
audit.why: Unstoppable Force is 130/115/100; Granite Shield absorbs 10% of his max HP and recharges only after he goes a few seconds without being hit; Seismic Shard is a flat 8s, Ground Slam a flat 7s; Fiora W is 24s.
audit.corrected: breakdown.cooldowns, dosFull[0].d, dosFull[2].d and dontsFull[1].d now carry 130s, the 10% shield and its recharge rule, and the 24s parry.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page calls Q 'Ground Slam' and attributes a movement slow to it. Q is Seismic Shard (it steals move speed for 3s); Ground Slam is E and cuts ATTACK speed, not movement.
audit.why: Riot's text: Q 'sends a shard of the earth through the ground at his foe, dealing damage upon impact and stealing Move Speed for 3 seconds'; E 'reduces the Attack Speed of enemies'. The two are swapped in early, whys[2] and wants.foe[0], which sends the player dodging the wrong ability.
audit.corrected: early, whys[2] and wants.foe[0] now name Seismic Shard for the move-speed steal; dontsFull[0].d describes Thunderclap's aftershock window.

edits.before: Once he has Q and E his Ground Slam slow still pulls you out of Vital range and resets the trade in his favor before your crit lands.
edits.after: Once he has Q and E, Seismic Shard steals your move speed and pulls you out of Vital range, resetting the trade before your crit lands.

edits.before: Land Ground Slam's slow to kite your Lunge out of Vital range and poke you down
edits.after: Land Seismic Shard to steal your move speed and kite your Lunge out of Vital range

edits.before: Do not be fooled by the tank-shredder reputation — early Malphite is annoying because his W passive hands him free armor plus one empowered auto, and his Q (Ground Slam) slow lets him poke and walk out of your Lunge range. At Levels 1-3 his short trades actually beat yours if you facecheck a Q. Last-hit by popping Vitals with Lunge at max range, chase the side the Vital marks, and only commit an E-Bladework crit-Vital combo when his Q is on cooldown — otherwise he slows you, the Vital re-marks awkwardly, and the trade evens out.
edits.after: Do not be fooled by the tank-shredder reputation — early Malphite is annoying because his W passive hands him free armor plus one empowered auto, and his Q (Seismic Shard) steals your move speed so he pokes and walks out of Lunge range. At Levels 1-3 his short trades actually beat yours if you facecheck a Q — it is a flat 8s. Last-hit by popping Vitals with Lunge at max range, chase the side the Vital marks, and only commit an E-Bladework crit-Vital combo once that 8s is spent.

edits.before: - Malphite Unstoppable Force: matchup-defining — Saved for fights. Lane is fine without it. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Malphite Unstoppable Force: matchup-defining — 130s at rank 1, saved for fights; parry it and the knockup returns as your stun. - Granite Shield: 10% max HP, and it recharges only if he goes unhit. - Riposte: 24s, held for his R.
